name: Kiwamete! Scandal!?
original_name: きわめて!スキャンダル!?
source:
Main hero lives in a luxury condominium and has fun every day.

One time his father got into an accident and his secretary urgently called main hero to take the lead of huge corporation instead of his father for the time of father's hospitalization.

This is how his three scandalous months began ...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公住在豪华公寓里，每天都过得逍遥快活。

某天，父亲意外受伤。秘书紧急联系主人公，要求他在父亲住院期间代为掌管那家庞大的企业。

就这样，他丑闻不断的三个月开始了……

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
